entries.name: Madang
entries.note: Town: provincial capital and main base on the Madang north-coast harbour; Wikivoyage's start point for the coast.
entries.reason: Kept; base passes the name test (see destinations-proposed.json name_evidence) and has the spots to fill a visit.

entries.name: Coastwatchers Lighthouse
entries.note: Landmark: working lighthouse on Madang harbour, a memorial to the WWII coastwatchers.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Madang and reached from that base.

entries.name: Madang Central Market
entries.note: Market: busy local market in the centre of Madang, open daily, with produce brought in from the Highlands.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Madang and reached from that base.

entries.name: Krangket Island
entries.note: Island: five-minute boat trip from Madang; two villages with gardens, a lagoon beach and a basic lodge.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Madang and reached from that base.

entries.name: USS Boston Wreck
entries.pin_needed: coordinates null: needs resolve-pin.py or the owner (not guessed)
entries.note: Wreck dive: US Navy minesweeper (converted Liberty ship) sunk on a reef drop-off off Madang, about 30 m deep.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Madang and reached from that base.
entries.within_span: unverified (no coordinates): described as nearby in source

entries.name: Balek Wildlife Sanctuary
entries.pin_needed: coordinates null: needs resolve-pin.py or the owner (not guessed)
entries.note: Nature: village wildlife sanctuary about 30 minutes from Madang, where a sulphur creek runs through a limestone cave to a clear stream with turtles and eels; tours via Melanesian Tourist Services.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Madang and reached from that base.
entries.within_span: unverified (no coordinates): described as nearby in source

entries.name: Magic Passage
entries.pin_needed: coordinates null: needs resolve-pin.py or the owner (not guessed)
entries.note: Dive site: narrow drift-dive passage about five minutes by boat from Madang Resort, with coral gardens and garden eels.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Madang and reached from that base.
entries.within_span: unverified (no coordinates): described as nearby in source

entries.name: Karkar Island
entries.note: Island: volcanic island 30 km off Madang with a caldera volcano (last big eruptions 1974-75), a ring road and views back to Madang; known for bilums.
entries.reason: About 63 km from Madang across the water, beyond 75% of Madang's span: standalone, with its own ring road.

entries.name: Lae
entries.note: Town: PNG's second city and Morobe's capital, at the start of the Highlands Highway; gateway to the Highlands and Huon Gulf.
entries.reason: Lae has only three kept neighbours (Botanic Gardens, War Cemetery, Rainforest Habitat): below four, so Lae is not a destination; standalone town. Wikivoyage "Lae" page exists; owner may promote it if Black Cat Track is pinned within reach.

entries.name: Lae Botanic Gardens
entries.note: Gardens: city gardens in central Lae with PNG plants, birds and an old aeroplane; not always open to the public (Wikipedia).
entries.reason: Lae cluster has three spots: standalone.

entries.name: Lae War Cemetery
entries.note: Cemetery: Commonwealth war cemetery with about 2,800 WWII burials, next to the botanic gardens and including the Lae Memorial.
entries.reason: Lae cluster has three spots: standalone.

entries.name: Rainforest Habitat
entries.note: Wildlife: 10-hectare animal and bird display at Lae University of Technology, with about 80 birds of paradise in a rainforest enclosure.
entries.reason: Lae cluster has three spots: standalone.

entries.name: Black Cat Track
entries.pin_needed: coordinates null: needs resolve-pin.py or the owner (not guessed)
entries.note: Trail: rough 3-4 day overland trek from Salamaua to Wau, a gold-rush and WWII route now used by experienced trekkers.
entries.reason: Salamaua to Wau trek; midpoint is far from Lae and the Wau/Bulolo group (Wau, Bulolo, Bulolo Gold Dredges, this track) has no destination name beyond a Wikivoyage Bulolo page, and is three plus the track only if the track counts. Treated as standalone (also leaves Bulolo/Wau as standalone). Pin needed.
entries.pin_flag: Wikipedia point is at Salamaua (trailhead), not the route midpoint; left null for resolve-pin / OSM route midpoint.

entries.name: Wau
entries.note: Town: gold-rush town at about 1,100 m, the Black Cat Track's inland end, with the Wau Ecology Institute nearby.
entries.reason: Wau, Bulolo, Bulolo Gold Dredges and Black Cat Track: no name travellers use for the group (Wikivoyage covers Bulolo only); standalone.

entries.name: Bulolo
entries.note: Town: former gold-dredging town on the Bulolo River, 32 km north-west of Wau, with dredge relics and a golf course.
entries.reason: Wikivoyage has a "Bulolo" page but the valley has only the dredges and Wau as neighbours: standalone.

entries.name: Bulolo Gold Dredges
entries.pin_needed: coordinates null: needs resolve-pin.py or the owner (not guessed)
entries.note: Relic: eight 2,000-tonne gold dredges airlifted into the Bulolo valley; some abandoned in the valley and still visible (Wikivoyage).
entries.reason: Part of the Bulolo valley; standalone. Pin needed.

reviews.name: Madang Museum
reviews.reason: Rule 1 only via Wikipedia citing Lonely Planet; small ethnographic museum open to visitors but I could not open a counted page.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: real museum with collections, guidebook-cited. Against: no counted source I could open, tiny, opening reliability unknown.

reviews.name: Bil Bil Village
reviews.reason: Rule 1: single city-guide mention (clay pot making), tour only.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: traditional pottery village on the coast is a real cultural draw. Against: one source, operator tour, village.

reviews.name: Hobe Village
reviews.reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage Do names village stay with birdwatching and WWII hideouts.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: Wikivoyage names it with contacts and activities. Against: it is mainly a homestay and not a drop-in stop.

reviews.name: Madang Japanese WWII Airfield
reviews.reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage Do names it (overgrown airfield, Betty bomber), half-day tour.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: distinctive WWII relics, source names it. Against: one source, jungle-covered, access via tour, exact site unclear.

reviews.name: Tupira Surf Club
reviews.reason: Rule 1: one city-guide mention; a surf break 90 min up the coast.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: named as the place to surf, hosted 2017 World Longboard Championships. Against: one source, surf club venue, remote.

reviews.name: Mitchell Bomber Wreck (Madang)
reviews.reason: Rule 1: Underwater Asia names it as an excellent WWII plane wreck; only one dive guide opened.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: permanent dive site named by a guide. Against: one source, shallow wreck, divers only.

reviews.name: Planet Rock
reviews.reason: Rule 1: Underwater Asia calls it one of the area's most famous dive sites; no second source found.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: famous site. Against: one source, advanced current/shark dive, only via operators.

reviews.name: Coral Queen Wreck
reviews.reason: Rule 1: one dive guide (night dive with flashlight fish).
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: distinctive night-dive draw. Against: one source, divers only.

reviews.name: Lae Main Market
reviews.reason: Rules 1-4: only Wikipedia ('best food market in PNG'); no counted source and trading days unstated.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: big food market in the second city. Against: no counted source, unclear daily trading.

reviews.name: Finschhafen
reviews.reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage PNG mentions it only as a ship stop from Lae; Wikipedia gives WWII and mission history.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: town with WWII sites on the peninsula. Against: passing mention, weekly ship, no named things to do.

reviews.name: Salamaua
reviews.reason: Rule 1: Wikipedia only, though Wikivoyage mentions the trail ending there; WWII ruins, boat from Lae.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: trek endpoint, historic port. Against: no counted page names it; small village.

reviews.name: Aseki and Watama
reviews.reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage Go next names the smoked burials; remote, needs a guide.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: distinctive cultural site named by a guide. Against: ~100 km remote, needs local arrangements, ethical concerns.

note: PNG has no existing destinations or spots. Placement run jointly for all nine regions; proposed destinations are in curation/png/destinations-proposed.json.
